title: Do not insult the source of life
summary: The line rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source of life. Let conduct answer before performance does.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: The line rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source of life.
source.lifeApplication: When contempt enters the room, refuse language that insults the source of life.

evidence.coreClaim: The line rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source of life.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: refuse to despise the one through whom human life comes.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.
